name: Music
short_desc: Your music player and library. Add music connector apps, like YouTube Music, for online songs.
description: Test release: your own files play on any Wizard. Online search, radio and songs come from music connector apps you install separately, starting with YouTube Music. Music finds them automatically, the way Money finds bank connections. No bundled music or account.
author: Humanity Labs
